fields.statement: Verified at deb4f262 (leaf commits 54220972, 7391c16a, deb4f262). Read the diff: daemonPoll1 and daemonDemand read ship and signoff through workflowStageMode(ship-change), which uses the workflow's declaration and falls back to rhiza.autonomy.<stage>; runRunGate and the autonomy accept rule read the accept stage from the run's recorded workflow autonomy (stateStageMode, acceptStageMode) and fall back to the setting; planRunAutonomous already reads the plan or plan-milestone workflow's plan stage. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<name> with fake rex and RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG, and all passed: workflow-plan-autonomy (plan.toml autonomous=true + setting owner starts the feature request's plan run with --autonomous; plan.toml plan=owner + setting auto starts it without; ship-change.toml plan=auto + setting owner starts it without), workflow-stage-autonomy (ship-change ship=auto starts a ready change set under setting owner; signoff=owner starts run start without --autonomous under setting auto; plan=auto alone leaves ship on the setting; accept=owner in both a custom workflow and a repo plan.toml leaves the gate's drafts proposed under accept auto), and unchanged stage-autonomy, plan-milestone-workflow, autonomy-accept-rule, autonomous-gate-rule, run-autonomy-source, run-autonomous, autonomous-review, review-signoff-autonomous, plan-workflow-autonomous and plan-workflow-autonomous-left. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... printed PASS for every test, and then the package's guard reported a write to ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json. That is the known environment leak under the enclosing ~/code root and is not caused by this leaf. Both findings from attempt 1 are covered.
